title: Check If String Is a Prefix of Array
summary: Evaluate if a given string s matches the prefix of an array of strings words by checking if s can be formed by joining the initial segments of words up to a certain index.
statement: Evaluate if a given string s matches the prefix of an array of strings words by checking if s can be formed by joining the initial segments of words up to a certain index.
constraints: words has 1 through 100 nonempty lowercase words, each of length at most 20.
Return true only when s equals words[0]+...+words[k] for some complete-word endpoint k.
hints: Matching characters is not enough: success is allowed only immediately after consuming a whole word.
Accumulate complete words while comparing each newly occupied slice of s, returning true exactly at equal total length.
For each word, advance length; reject overflow or slice mismatch; accept when length==len(s).
The invariant says s[:length] equals the concatenation of processed whole words. Equality at a boundary proves success; mismatch, overflow, or exhausting words proves no later valid prefix.
editorial: The invariant says s[:length] equals the concatenation of processed whole words. Equality at a boundary proves success; mismatch, overflow, or exhausting words proves no later valid prefix.

tests.explanation: The first three complete words concatenate exactly to s.
The concatenation disagrees from the first word, so s is not a prefix string.
